item.title: How the Iran war is disrupting air travel -- and advice if you're planning a trip
item.summary: The war in Iran is roiling jet fuel prices and airlines are beginning to hike prices, unsettling travelers far from the Middle East. If you're booking a flight soon, here are things to know.

item.title: Countries agree to a historic release of stockpiled oil to ease global disruption
item.summary: Members of the International Energy Agency have announced a coordinated release of 400 million barrels of stockpiled oil in an attempt to counter the disruption in oil trade triggered by the Iran war.

item.title: The U.S. attacks Iranian mine-laying vessels near the Strait of Hormuz
item.summary: Attacks and counterattacks continued throughout the Middle East Wednesday. Two cargo ships were struck in the Gulf, as some lawmakers in Washington pressed for answers on the war's rationale.

item.title: The 2026 Oscars' best original song nominees, cruelly ranked
item.summary: There are two clear frontrunners in this year's best original song race, either of which would be a worthy Oscar winner. Diane Warren is also nominated, for the 17th time.

item.title: ChatGPT might give you bad medical advice, studies warn
item.summary: New research finds AI can point people in the wrong direction. And the quality of health information it imparts depends on how well you prompt the tools.

item.title: Greetings from a Shanghai temple where you can ward off bad luck in the Year of the Horse
item.summary: According to Chinese mythology, those born in the Year of the Horse will clash with Tai Sui, a heavenly general. Luckily, there are ways to appease Tai Sui, including amulets at Shanghai's Jade Buddha Temple.

item.title: No Nobles Day: Britain's Parliament boots its last hereditary Lords after 700 years
item.summary: Government minister Nick Thomas-Symonds said the change put an end to "an archaic and undemocratic principle." The removed aristocrats are 92 of the House of Lords' 800 members.

item.title: On her new album, Kacey Musgraves returns home, to the 'Middle of Nowhere'
item.summary: Before making her upcoming sixth album, the country star returned to her small-town Texas home and discovered the power of in-between spaces. "I found a lot of clarity there," she says.

item.title: Marty Crunchwrap Supreme and more menu ideas for your 2026 Oscars party
item.summary: You're inviting folks over to watch the Oscars, but you want to serve them a bill-of-fare that reflects this year's idiosyncratic slate of best picture nominees. We can help with that.

item.title: Over puppy yoga? Try it with snakes.
item.summary: You've heard of yoga with kittens, and goats, and maybe even reindeer… but what about a bunch of pythons and one baby Columbian Common Boa named Mango?
